query: with selected as (select c.id, sub.name as subject, c.is_active, c.is_validated, c.source_url, c.source_reference from public.citations c join public.subjects sub on sub.id = c.subject_id where (sub.name = 'Français' and c.author in ('Jean de La Fontaine','Voltaire') and c.source_url like 'https://fr.wikisource.org/wiki/%') or (sub.name = 'Philosophie' and c.author in ('René Descartes','Jean-Jacques Rousseau') and c.source_url like 'https://fr.wikisource.org/wiki/%') or (sub.name = 'Histoire-Géographie' and c.author = 'Assemblée générale des Nations Unies' and c.source_url = 'https://www.un.org/fr/about-us/universal-declaration-of-human-rights') or (sub.name = 'Physique-Chimie' and c.author = 'Henri Poincaré' and c.source_url like 'https://fr.wikisource.org/wiki/La_Science%')) select subject, count(distinct id) as citation_count, count(distinct id) filter (where is_active = false and is_validated = false) as draft_count, count(distinct id) filter (where source_url is not null and source_reference is not null) as sourced_count from selected group by subject order by subject limit 10;
